title: fix(plugin-security): member_default grants sys_comment_reaction read + create, so a stock member can react to comments they can read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_
Fixes #33584
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:平台基线权限集 `member_default` 新增一行 `sys_comment_reaction` 授权(只读 + 新建,不可编辑、不可删除),普通成员可以对自己能看到的评论点表情回应。
- **为什么改**:维护者 2026-11-15 对 #33584 选了方案 A「成员默认可回应」;此前没有任何内置权限集包含该对象,普通成员点回应一律 403。
- **风险与回滚**:风险在于成员能看到哪些回应;行级范围仍由 plugin-audit 的评论门控决定(只看/只回应可读评论,删除只走本人回应的专用门),无新增行级策略,`external_default` 不变。回滚 = 删掉这一行。
- **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`(新增授权行及注释);② `packages/qa/dogfood/test/comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps.dogfood.test.ts`(新 describe:仅持基线的成员);③ `default-permission-sets.test.ts`(单元钉子 + 外部用户对照)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 9/9 通过;删掉授权行重建 plugin-security 后,新 describe 的 4 条全部转红(POST 返回 403)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `member_default` gains `sys_comment_reaction: { allowRead: true, allowCreate: true, allowEdit: false, allowDelete: false }`, placed right after the `sys_comment` / `sys_activity` pair, with a comment citing the maintainer decision on #33584 (option A). No row-level policy is added (the reaction tripwire in `default-permission-sets.test.ts` forbids one). `external_default` is untouched.
- Which rows a member reaches is unchanged: plugin-audit's comment gate lists and reads a reaction only on a comment the caller can read, refuses an insert on any other comment (`403 RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`) and stamps `user_id` from the session. Unreact stays the own-row door `DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id`, which removes only a row whose `created_by` is the caller; the baseline carries no delete bit (ADR-0090 D5).
- The header of `comment-reaction-own-record-floor.test.ts` no longer calls the grant "an open decision on #22566": read and create are the baseline's now, and the delete bit on the generic data door still comes from an app's position-distributed set.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-security` patch.

## Tests

- **Unit pin** (`default-permission-sets.test.ts`, new top-level describe): `member_default`'s parsed `sys_comment_reaction` entry equals exactly read + create, with edit, delete, transfer, view-all and modify-all all `false`. CONTROL: `external_default` names no `sys_comment_reaction` grant.
- **Dogfood pin** (`comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps.dogfood.test.ts`, new top-level describe on the comments fixture with plugin-audit, org-bound). The members hold the app's own read-only baseline composed with `member_default`. An arming probe checks that every other set they hold, as the security catalog serves it, names neither `sys_comment_reaction` nor a wildcard. The four cases:
  - a member reacts to a readable comment (`201`, `user_id` = caller) and lists that comment's reactions (both members' rows);
  - a member unreacts their own reaction through the own-row door (`200`, row gone);
  - a member cannot remove another member's reaction: own-row door `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, data door `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, row survives;
  - CONTROL: an unfiltered `GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` contains the member's reaction on the readable comment and omits the admin's reaction on the unreadable one, which still exists.
  - CONTROL, on a comment the member cannot read: the reaction is not listed (`200`, empty `records`), not read by id (`404`), not removed (`404`, row survives), and an insert is refused (`403 RECORD_NOT_ACCESSIBLE`) with nothing stored.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise measured before the fix by ablating the grant line, which leaves plugin-security's source equal to `origin/main` `4bba8b8f02` apart from comments. With the grant ablated, a stock member's `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` answered `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, and so did `GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction?$filter=…`. The card's premise holds.
- The grant line sits after `sys_activity`, not directly under `sys_comment`, so the existing comment above the pair ("These two lines open the OBJECTS") stays true.
- `comment-reaction-unreact-door.integration.test.ts` still grants reactions through an app every-member set. That grant now duplicates `member_default`'s but is harmless, so the file is left as is.
- Out of scope, per the card: the console's choice of store (it PATCHes the retired `sys_comment.reactions` column) is #33521.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, per review: a stock member's `POST` / `GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` goes from `403` to `201` / `200`, which widens what the data door accepts. The precedents are the `sys_user` AI-readable change and #32442. `Metadata-protocol: none` and the `patch` level stay. No published schema or export changes, and no authorable-surface, census or generated baseline moved (see Verification).

## Verification

- unit: `× member_default carries exactly read + create on sys_comment_reaction` (1 failed | 31 passed);
- dogfood: the 4 new cases all `×`, each `expected 403 to be 201` / `expected 403 to be 200`, body `{"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","object":"sys_comment_reaction"}`; the 5 pre-existing cases stayed green.

Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. Rebuilt plugin-security; preflight: marker present in 2 built files, tree clean.
